logo.note: Adobe's logo, since Spectrum has no mark of its own (the Spectrum site's header uses it beside the name), unaltered, from https://spectrum.adobe.com/. Shown at the request of Polyxd's maintainer to identify the design system this pack is modelled on. Adobe's guidelines: Use of Adobe logos (corporate or product) is not allowed unless licensed by Adobe; the names may be used referentially ('for use with', 'compatible with').

provenance.notes: The token file is vendored verbatim as scripts/sources/spectrum/variables.json; the generator resolves each token's light/dark set at the desktop scale.
